integrity: The mathematical proof is self-contained. Numerical checking uses Python and NumPy; no claim of formal or independent proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Not extended to nonreduced rings, normalized/Laplacian spectra, or noncommutative rings. The original 2025 preprint was withdrawn in September 2026 for restructuring; v1 remains a dated source of the graph definition and stated spectral problem. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded. Computational examples are finite corroboration, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_scope: Finite reduced commutative nonfields, expressed as products of at least two finite fields; exact adjacency eigenvalues/multiplicities, incidence rank and nullity.
title: Complete adjacency spectrum of the bipartite zero-divisor–unit graph of finite reduced rings
